Each lane operates under strict categorization logic—feeds are either flowing, scheduled, or catalogued; methods are either implemented or not. This binary classification ensures deterministic behavior and traceability. The failure mode occurs when a feed cannot be classified, indicating a misalignment between access control and data infrastructure. The reasoning engine must maintain consistency across these lanes, validating that all inputs are properly wired before advancing. The dual nature of the system lies in its ability to handle both structured and unstructured data sources, with the latter being catalogued for future resolution. The system’s robustness depends on maintaining a clean separation between data ingestion and inference layers, preventing cross-contamination of states.
